pairs.target: ā duō zài yuē hǎo de bàngwǎn dào le xuégōng , tí zhe zìjǐ de dēng , lìngyìzhī shǒu niē zhe yìzhī kǎo dé fāyìng de bǐng .
pairs.english: Ado reached the academy at the agreed dusk, carrying his lamp and a bread cake baked rock-hard.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多在约好的傍晚到了学宫，提着自己的灯，另一只手捏着一只烤得发硬的饼。

pairs.target: " lùshang mǎi de . nǐmen yào buyào ? "
pairs.english: “Bought it on the way. Want some?”
pairs.hanzi: “路上买的。你们要不要？”

pairs.target: pà wò shēnshǒu , bāi le bàntiān méi bāikāi .
pairs.english: Pavo reached for it and struggled to break it.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃伸手，掰了半天没掰开。

pairs.target: ā duō shuō yá hǎo yě búbì xiànzài zhèngmíng , wǎndiǎn pàotāng jiù xíng .
pairs.english: Ado said there was no need to prove his teeth now; it could soak in soup later.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多说牙好也不必现在证明，晚点泡汤就行。

pairs.target: shì dēng de dìfāng zài dōng wūwài de píng yuànlǐ .
pairs.english: The lamp trial was in the level courtyard outside the east room.
pairs.hanzi: 试灯的地方在东屋外的平院里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǎo bǎ mùxiāng páikāi , liúchū zhuǎnshēn de kòngdì ;
pairs.english: Tavi had arranged the crates early, leaving space to turn;
pairs.hanzi: 塔维早把木箱排开，留出转身的空地；

pairs.target: táijiē xiàmiàn lìngwài zhàn zhe wéi lǎoshī , děnghuìer ruò yào shì nà sānjí shíjiē , yě zhī ràng kōngshǒu de rén zǒu .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey stood below the steps, where any later trial on the three stone stairs would be empty-handed.
pairs.hanzi: 台阶下面另外站着维老师，等会儿若要试那三级石阶，也只让空手的人走。

pairs.target: sū yǐ nálái jìlùzhǐ , yīwén shuō zìjǐ zhǐnéng dài dào zhōngxiǎng , héchàng nàbiān jīnwǎn yǒurén děng tā lǐng xīn duànzǐ .
pairs.english: Suyi brought recording paper; Iven could stay only until the bell, since the choir expected him to lead a new verse tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡拿来记录纸，伊文说自己只能待到钟响，合唱那边今晚有人等他领新段子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dáyīng dé hěnkuài . tā juéde búyòng nàme jiǔ .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed quickly. He thought it wouldn't take that long.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应得很快。他觉得不用那么久。

pairs.target: sìtiān lǐ , zhǐ zhào yǐjīng huànchéng báo jīnshǔ zhào , mùbǎn cháo dēng de yímiàn yě jiā le gérè de kòngxì .
pairs.english: Over four days, the paper hood had become thin metal, with an insulating gap on the board's lamp-facing side.
pairs.hanzi: 四天里，纸罩已经换成薄金属罩，木板朝灯的一面也加了隔热的空隙。

pairs.target: suǒyǒu zhǐpiàn hé sàn shéng dōu cóng diǎnhuǒ de dìfāng shōuzǒu le .
pairs.english: All paper scraps and loose cords had been cleared from the lighting area.
pairs.hanzi: 所有纸片和散绳都从点火的地方收走了。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī xiān kàn gùdìng chù , zài yàn dēngzhǎn hé cányóu ,
pairs.english: Instructor Vey checked the mounts, then the oil cup and remaining oil,
pairs.hanzi: 维老师先看固定处，再验灯盏和残油，

pairs.target: bǎ tā fàngzài yuànzhōng de shítái shàng diǎnliàng , děng zhào biān rè qǐlái hòu cái jiǎnchá yīfu yícè .
pairs.english: lit it on the courtyard stone stand, and waited for the hood edge to warm before checking the clothing side.
pairs.hanzi: 把它放在院中的石台上点亮，等罩边热起来后才检查衣服一侧。

pairs.target: ā duō zhàn zài pángbiān , shuāngshǒu chā zhe yāo , xiàng yígè děng zhe biérén xiūhǎo zìjǐ yīfu de rén .
pairs.english: Ado stood with hands on his hips, like someone waiting for others to mend his clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多站在旁边，双手插着腰，像一个等着别人修好自己衣服的人。

pairs.target: " guà dé shàng . " tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù xiān shuō .
pairs.english: “It fits,” Tavi couldn't help saying first.
pairs.hanzi: “挂得上。”塔维忍不住先说。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . wǒ yào de shì guà zhe yǐhòu hái néng gànhuó . "
pairs.english: “I know. I need to work with it fitted.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。我要的是挂着以后还能干活。”

pairs.target: pà wò pū dì xiào le , yòu gǎnjǐn dītóu qù kěn bǐng .
pairs.english: Pavo snorted, then quickly lowered his head to gnaw the cake.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃噗地笑了，又赶紧低头去啃饼。

pairs.target: dēng zhuāngjìn jiàzi , ā duō xì shàng kuāndài , zài píngdìshàng zǒu le jǐbù .
pairs.english: The lamp went into the frame; Ado fastened the broad belt and walked a few steps on level ground.
pairs.hanzi: 灯装进架子，阿多系上宽带，在平地上走了几步。

pairs.target: méiyǒu zhuǎn dào bèihòu , yě méi pèng tuǐ .
pairs.english: It neither swung behind him nor hit his legs.
pairs.hanzi: 没有转到背后，也没碰腿。

pairs.target: zhào bǎ huǒguāng dǎng zài wàimiàn , tā dītóu kànzhe jiǎo biān nà yìxiǎokuài liàng chù , diǎn le diǎntóu .
pairs.english: The hood kept the flame outside; looking at the patch of light beside his feet, he nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 罩把火光挡在外面，他低头看着脚边那一小块亮处，点了点头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐjīng xiǎng hǎo yào gěi sè lā xiě nǎ yíjù le .
pairs.english: Tavi had already chosen the sentence he'd write to Sela.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维已经想好要给瑟拉写哪一句了。

pairs.target: jiēzhe , ā duō bào qǐ yìzhī kōngxiāng .
pairs.english: Then Ado picked up an empty crate.
pairs.hanzi: 接着，阿多抱起一只空箱。

pairs.target: xiāngzǐ dǎngzhù wǎng xià kàn de shìxiàn , tā biàn zhào píngcháng gànhuó de zīshì , bǎ xiāng jiǎo wǎng zuǒ jiān tái le yìdiǎn , shēnzi yě cè guòqù .
pairs.english: The crate blocked his downward view, so he lifted its corner towards his left shoulder, as he did at work, turning his body too.
pairs.hanzi: 箱子挡住往下看的视线，他便照平常干活的姿势，把箱角往左肩抬了一点，身子也侧过去。

pairs.target: guāng gēnzhe yāo zhuǎn , dìshàng nà piàn liàng chù huá dào pángbiān .
pairs.english: The light turned with his waist, its patch sliding sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 光跟着腰转，地上那片亮处滑到旁边。

pairs.target: zhèngqiánfāng qiàhǎo hēi le .
pairs.english: Directly ahead was dark.
pairs.hanzi: 正前方恰好黑了。

pairs.target: ā duō tíngxià , fàng huí xiāngzǐ . " zhè jiù bùxíng . "
pairs.english: Ado stopped and set down the crate. “That won't do.”
pairs.hanzi: 阿多停下，放回箱子。“这就不行。”

pairs.target: " nǐ bié nàme zhuǎn . " tǎ wéi tuōkǒuérchū .
pairs.english: “Don't turn like that,” Tavi blurted.
pairs.hanzi: “你别那么转。”塔维脱口而出。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ jìng le yíxià .
pairs.english: The yard fell quiet for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 院里静了一下。

pairs.target: tā zìjǐ yě tīngjiàn zhèhuà yǒu duō guài : bào zhe dōngxī de rén rúguǒ bùnéng zhào píngcháng de yàngzi dòng ,
pairs.english: He heard how strange that sounded himself: if a person carrying things couldn't move normally,
pairs.hanzi: 他自己也听见这话有多怪：抱着东西的人如果不能照平常的样子动，

pairs.target: nà tā jiūjìng tì ā duō kōng chū le shénme ?
pairs.english: what exactly had he freed up for Ado?
pairs.hanzi: 那他究竟替阿多空出了什么？

pairs.target: ā duō méishēngqì , zhī jiào tā zhàn dào zìjǐ pángbiān , bǎ tóngyì zhī xiāngzǐ bào qǐlái .
pairs.english: Ado wasn't angry; he asked Tavi to stand beside him and lift the same crate.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多没生气，只叫他站到自己旁边，把同一只箱子抱起来。

pairs.target: xiāngdǐ bǐ xiǎngxiàng zhōng kuān , tǎ wéi de gēbo rào bú guòqù , zhǐnéng xiàng tā yíyàng lüè cè zhe shēn .
pairs.english: Its base was wider than expected; Tavi couldn't get his arms around it, and had to turn slightly too.
pairs.hanzi: 箱底比想象中宽，塔维的胳膊绕不过去，只能像他一样略侧着身。

alignment.english: couldn't get his arms around it

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng huà guò de yíqiè , dōu méi bǎ zhè zhī xiāngzǐ huà jìnqù .
pairs.english: None of the drawings had included that crate.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上画过的一切，都没把这只箱子画进去。

pairs.target: tāmen yòu shì le tí shuǐtǒng .
pairs.english: They tried carrying a bucket next.
pairs.hanzi: 他们又试了提水桶。

pairs.target: dēng de wèizhì méi zhuǎn , liàngguāng què zài màibù shí bèizhào yán jiézhù , zhào dédào xié jiān , zhàobúdào xià yíbù yào luò de dìmiàn .
pairs.english: The lamp stayed in place, but its hood cut off the beam during each step, lighting shoe tips instead of the next foothold.
pairs.hanzi: 灯的位置没转，亮光却在迈步时被罩沿截住，照得到鞋尖，照不到下一步要落的地面。

pairs.target: dào táijiē qián , wéi lǎoshī ràng tāmen xiān tíng , zìjǐ bǎ lìng yìzhǎn shǒu dēng yí dào xià yījí .
pairs.english: At the stairs, Instructor Vey stopped them and moved another hand lamp to the step below.
pairs.hanzi: 到台阶前，维老师让他们先停，自己把另一盏手灯移到下一级。

pairs.target: liǎngzhǎn dēng bìngpái yí zhào , quē diào de nà kuài ànchù biàn hěn qīngchǔ le .
pairs.english: Side by side, the two lamps made the missing dark patch obvious.
pairs.hanzi: 两盏灯并排一照，缺掉的那块暗处便很清楚了。

pairs.target: yīwén de zhōngxiǎng le .
pairs.english: Iven's bell rang.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文的钟响了。

pairs.target: tā bǎ jì zhe liǎngzhǒng zīshì de zhǐ dìgěi sū yǐ , bèi qǐ bāo , shuō jīntiān dé xiān zǒu .
pairs.english: He handed Suyi the sheet showing both postures, shouldered his bag, and said he had to leave now.
pairs.hanzi: 他把记着两种姿势的纸递给苏苡，背起包，说今天得先走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi chàdiǎn jiàozhù tā , zuìhòu zhī wèn míngtiān néng bunéng jiè nà zhī cū bǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi nearly called him back, but finally only asked to borrow his broad pen tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维差点叫住他，最后只问明天能不能借那支粗笔。

pairs.target: " bǐ kěyǐ . rén méikòng . " " zhīdào le . "
pairs.english: “The pen is free. I'm not.” “Understood.”
pairs.hanzi:
“笔可以。人没空。”
“知道了。”

pairs.target: yīwén pǎo guò méndòng shí hái huítóu huī le huīshǒu .
pairs.english: Iven turned to wave as he ran through the gateway.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文跑过门洞时还回头挥了挥手。

pairs.target: pà wò tì tā bǎ shèngxià de bǐng shōu hǎo , shuō héchàng de rén yàoshi è le , zhìshǎo néng ná tā dǎpāizi .
pairs.english: Pavo saved the remaining cake for him, saying hungry singers could at least beat time with it.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃替他把剩下的饼收好，说合唱的人要是饿了，至少能拿它打拍子。

pairs.target: ā duō jiě xià jiàzi , děng dēng lěng xiē zài zhuāng huí tí bǐng .
pairs.english: Ado removed the frame, waiting for the lamp to cool before refitting its handle.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多解下架子，等灯冷些再装回提柄。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ jīntiān dàocǐwéizhǐ de jìlù fàngzài shítái shàng , huíqù suǒ gōngjùguì .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey left the record ending today's session on the stone stand, then went to lock the tool cupboard.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把今天到此为止的记录放在石台上，回去锁工具柜。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ shèngxià tāmen jǐgè , wǎnfēng chuī guò dēngzhào , dàilái yìdiǎn kǎo tiě de qìwèi .
pairs.english: Only the few of them remained, evening wind across the hood bringing a trace of heated iron.
pairs.hanzi: 院里剩下他们几个，晚风吹过灯罩，带来一点烤铁的气味。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe dìmiàn shuō : " wǒ gěi nǐ xiěxìn de shíhòu , hǎoxiàng yǐjīng kuài zuòchéng le . "
pairs.english: Tavi stared at the ground. “In my letter to you, I made it sound nearly done.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯着地面说：“我给你写信的时候，好像已经快做成了。”

pairs.target: " hái méi ràng wǒ fùqián . " ā duō shuō , " xiànzài gǎikǒu bù wǎn . "
pairs.english: “You haven't charged me yet,” Ado said. “Not too late to change your story.”
pairs.hanzi: “还没让我付钱。”阿多说，“现在改口不晚。”

pairs.target: tā dūnxià , yòng yìxiǎokuài báishí zài dìshàng huà le liǎngdào , biāochū zìjǐ bān xiāng shí zuì xiǎng kànqīng de wèizhì .
pairs.english: He crouched and drew two lines with a small white stone, marking where he most needed to see when carrying a crate.
pairs.hanzi: 他蹲下，用一小块白石在地上划了两道，标出自己搬箱时最想看清的位置。

pairs.target: búshì yígè zhèngyuán , yě búzhèng duì shēnzi , érshì qiánmiàn piānwài de yípiàn .
pairs.english: It wasn't a perfect circle or straight ahead, but a patch forward and outward.
pairs.hanzi: 不是一个正圆，也不正对身子，而是前面偏外的一片。

pairs.target: tā ràng tǎ wéi zhànjìnlái , zài zǒu chūqù , zhècì bù ná dēng , zhī kàn jiǎo huì luò zài nǎér .
pairs.english: He had Tavi step in and out, this time without a lamp, just watching where his feet would land.
pairs.hanzi: 他让塔维站进来，再走出去，这次不拿灯，只看脚会落在哪儿。

pairs.target: huí ménfáng shí , tiān yǐjīng quán àn .
pairs.english: By their return to the gatehouse, it was fully dark.
pairs.hanzi: 回门房时，天已经全暗。

pairs.target: ā duō háishì tí zhe jiù dēng , yìng bǐng liúgěi tāmen , shuō míngtiān búhuì zài lái děng , zuò dé chàbùduō le zài jiào tā .
pairs.english: Ado still carried his old lamp, leaving them the hard cake and saying he wouldn't come wait tomorrow; call when it was nearly ready.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多还是提着旧灯，硬饼留给他们，说明天不会再来等，做得差不多了再叫他。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi sòngdào lùkǒu , méiyǒu zàishuō háiyào jǐtiān .
pairs.english: Tavi saw him to the junction without promising how many more days.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维送到路口，没有再说还要几天。

pairs.target: huí yuànlǐ , tā bǎ xiě zhe " kěyǐ jiāogěi ā duō " de nà zhāng zhǐ fānguòlái , chóngxīn huà xià dìshàng de liǎngdào báixiàn .
pairs.english: Back in the yard, he turned over the paper saying “Ready for Ado” and copied the two white lines again.
pairs.hanzi: 回院里，他把写着“可以交给阿多”的那张纸翻过来，重新画下地上的两道白线。

pairs.target: sū yǐ tì tā jǔ zhe dēng . shuí yě méi jí zhe bǎ nà piàn ànchù tú chéngliàng de .
pairs.english: Suyi held a lamp for him. Neither hurried to colour that dark patch bright.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡替他举着灯。谁也没急着把那片暗处涂成亮的。
